review_candidates.title: Vice President, Data Center Operations
review_candidates.description: Montera is seeking a Senior Vice President of Data Center Operations to build and lead our global operations platform as we scale a next-generation hyperscale data center portfolio. Reporting directly to COO, this individual will be responsible for developing the operational strategy, standards, systems, and teams required to deliver industry-leading reliability, safety, efficiency, and customer experience across our growing fleet. The ideal candidate brings deep experience leading hyperscale or mission-critical infrastructure operations, with a proven track record spanning operational readiness, facility operations, engineering, reliability programs, construction-to-operations transitions, and large-scale organizational leadership. This executive will partner closely with Development, Design & Construction, Delivery, Procurement, Finance, and Commercial teams to ensure Montera's facilities operate at the highest standards of performance while supporting rapid growth. What You'll Do Develop and execute Montera's long-term operations strategy for a rapidly expanding hyperscale data center portfolio. Build and lead a high-performing operations organization responsible for critical facilities, engineering, maintenance, reliability, and operational readiness. Establish operational standards, governance models, policies, procedures, and best practices across all sites. Lead the transition from design and construction through commissioning, turnover, operational readiness, and live operations. Develop and implement reliability-centered maintenance (RCM), asset management, and lifecycle management programs across critical infrastructure. Drive operational excellence initiatives focused on uptime, efficiency, safety, capacity utilization, sustainability, and customer experience. Establish KPIs, reporting frameworks, and performance management systems to measure operational effectiveness across the portfolio. Partner with development and delivery teams to ensure operational requirements are embedded into facility design standards and future deployments. Oversee CMMS/EAM platforms, work management systems, maintenance strategies, and operational technology programs. Lead vendor management, service partner relationships, and operational procurement activities. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that reduce risk, improve reliability, and optimize operating costs. Support customer engagement activities with hyperscale, AI, cloud, and enterprise clients as a senior operational representative. Manage annual operating budgets and support capital planning activities across the portfolio. Foster a culture centered on safety, accountability, collaboration, and operational excellence. Recruit, mentor, and develop future operations leaders across the organization. Requirements What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Construction Management, or a related technical field. 20+ years of experience leading mission-critical infrastructure, data center operations, semiconductor facilities, or large-scale industrial operations. 10+ years of executive leadership experience managing multi-site operations organizations. Demonstrated success operating hyperscale data centers supporting cloud, AI, or high-density compute environments. Experience leading operations across multiple campuses, regions, or global portfolios. Deep understanding of critical infrastructure systems, including electrical distribution, UPS, generators, cooling systems, controls, and mechanical systems. Proven experience developing operational readiness, commissioning, and construction-to-operations transition programs. Strong knowledge of reliability engineering methodologies, including RCM, FMEA, root cause analysis, and risk management frameworks. Experience implementing CMMS/EAM platforms and enterprise maintenance programs. Track record of building and leading large-scale operational organizations consisting of facility managers, engineers, technicians, and support personnel. Experience managing significant operating budgets, capital programs, and operational P&L responsibilities. Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Strong business acumen with the ability to balance operational performance, customer outcomes, and financial objectives. Experience supporting hyperscale customers, AI infrastructure environments, or large-scale cloud deployments preferred. Professional Engineer (PE), PMP, Uptime Institute, AFCOM, or related certifications are a plus. Benefits About Montera At Montera, we're building the future of digital infrastructure. Founder-led with $1.5B backed by Stonepeak, Montera is driven by a future-focused vision: to develop and operate hyperscale data centers essential for tomorrow's technology. Our mission is to deliver strategically located, hyperscale data centers designed for speed, reliability, and scalability. Backed by decades of experience in design, construction, and operations, we don't just build—we execute with purpose. Our Values Client First Alignment: We align every solution to our clients' goals. Speed with Certainty: Velocity matters. We deliver with urgency and precision. Operational Excellence: Decades of experience drive our high standards. Safety & Integrity: Safety is non-negotiable. We lead with integrity and transparency. Ownership Mentality: We think like owners, because we are. Why Join Montera? At Montera, you'll shape the next generation of digital infrastructure while being supported by a team that values integrity, collaboration, and long-term partnership. We're a remote-first company that empowers our people with flexibility, ownership, and meaningful rewards. Compensation: At Montera, we believe great work starts with investing in great people. That is why we offer a competitive and thoughtful total compensation package designed to recognize the value each team member brings. Our compensation ranges are informed by market data and aligned to job level and role. When making hiring and compensation decisions, we consider a variety of factors, including skills, experience, education, training, competencies, and overall business needs. The reasonable compensation range for this role is $275,000 - $325,000. Our Benefits at a Glance: Comprehensive Health Coverage: We pay 90% of health premiums for employees and their dependents. Generous Time Off: Up to 8 weeks of paid time off per year, which includes holidays, PTO, and sick time. Parental Leave: Up to 8 weeks of paid time off after 6 months of employment. Financial Security: 401(k) plan with immediate eligibility, no vesting requirement, and employer match contributions up to 6%. Learning & Development Reimbursement: Up to $3,500 reimbursed annually for approved courses, certifications, conferences and professional development opportunities. Extra Support: Remote work stipend to help you stay connected. At Montera, you'll have the autonomy to do great work and the benefits to thrive personally and professionally.

review_candidates.title: Engineer / Scientist / Technical or Mechanical Expert
review_candidates.description: Duration of contract: Five years, renewable (full-time) Location: Hybrid based in Germany (Munich/Berlin) or the Netherlands (The Hague) Application deadline: 02.11.2026 At the European Patent Office (EPO), we explore breakthrough technologies before they reach the public. As a patent examiner, you'll assess whether inventions meet the criteria for patent protection, and in doing so support innovation that improves lives, drives industries and shapes the future. We are an inclusive, purpose-driven organisation committed to sustainability, fairness and excellence – diversity is part of our DNA. Whether you come from research, academia or industry, if you're curious, open to learning and looking for a meaningful intellectual challenge you'll find your place at the EPO. Your role and impact As a Patent Examiner, you will: examine patent applications – including technical documentation and drawings – in one of our official languages (English, French or German) analyse new inventions to evaluate their novelty and inventive step conduct in-depth research using digital search tools, scientific databases and patent information sources to identify the most relevant prior art apply legal and procedural frameworks to make clear, high-quality decisions on whether a patent should be granted communicate your findings clearly and constructively with applicants and other parties collaborate with international colleagues in a diverse and inclusive environment maintain high-quality standards with strong attention to detail and scientific rigour contribute to Europe's innovation ecosystem by ensuring fair and consistent application of the European Patent Convention (EPC) and related legal texts Your profile We're looking for expertise in these fields: Applied Maths, AI, and Quantum Computing: artificial intelligence/machine learning, applied math & NLP, quantum computing Computer: ICT security or cryptography, network security, image processing, AR/AV, HCI, GUI, computer devices, AI applications, error detection & correction, distributed processing & CPU, software execution Electrical Engineering & Power Systems Electric Power Distribution & Protection (photovoltaic systems, wind turbines, hydropower plants etc, to grid/power networks) via AC and/or DC lines (including HVDC), power conversion, energy storage, wireless power transfer and battery charging technologies (e.g. EVs/HEVs charging) Electromechanics – electrical connectors Electrical Connectors, Electrical Connectors & Displays - coupling devices, terminals, and current collectors across automotive (including high-voltage/EV systems), industrial, and consumer applications. Key areas include electromechanical contact design, busbar assemblies, termination technologies (crimping, IDC, welding), board-to-board and cable-to-board interconnects, electromagnetic shielding (EMI/EMC), and mechanical latching and environmental sealing. Video Engineering: digital video coding and compression (MPEG, HEVC, VVC, point cloud), video transmission (DVB, ISOBMFF, HbbTV), digital cameras, image sensors and camera control Mechanical Engineering: Tobacco processing and aerosol generation, Air Conditioning, Heating Systems, Conveyors, Furniture and Hand Tools Medical Device Engineering: Medical Mechanics - design, development, testing or manufacture of medical devices and surgical technologies. Minimally invasive devices: catheters, guidewires, delivery systems; Drug delivery: microneedles, injectors and related devices; Surgical devices: surgical instruments, powered and robotic surgical systems; Spinal implants: pedicle screws, rods, intervertebral cages, disc prostheses Semiconductors: Semiconductor manufacturing technology, Lithography Technologies, Magnetic Applications and Electromagnetic Components, Lithography Chemistry (Photoresists & Photomasks), Physical aspects of OLED displays, lighting devices and organic photovoltaic devices, Semiconductor devices and manufacturing technology Telecom & Wireless : Messaging, Topology, Access, Multiple Access & Transmission Lines, Network Management, PowerSaving, Sync, SatCom, Resource Allocation, Wireless & Data Networks You will thrive with us if you have a solid background and relevant expertise in the specified fields, built up during your studies, in projects, and/or as a result of professional experience enjoy deep technical analysis, reading technical drawings and solving intellectual puzzles are genuinely curious about technology and enjoy continuously learning about new scientific developments, emerging technologies and patent law are analytical, detail-oriented and open-minded are confident using digital technologies and AI-supported tools to analyse information while applying own critical thinking value both independent work and team collaboration are comfortable making structured, evidence-based decisions and exercising sound professional judgement No prior IP (intellectual property) experience? No problem, we provide full training to get you started. Our minimum requirements for this post diploma of completed studies at master's level covering one or more technical fields mentioned above excellent knowledge (at least C1) of one of our official languages (English, French and German) and the ability to understand the other two; alternatively, excellent knowledge (at least C1) of English (in such cases, the willingness to learn the missing languages and to reach level B2 within a set time frame would be required) work experience in industry would be an advantage citizenship of one of the member states of the European Patent Organisation What we offer competitive salary: €7 076 to €10 164 net/month (depending on location and experience) 30+ days of annual leave + flexible working arrangements generous remote work policy: work from anywhere in the country of employment; up to 60 days from abroad (EPC states) family-friendly policies: childcare, education and relocation support pension and insurance: excellent social security coverage examiner training: a comprehensive two-year development programme covering all aspects of patent search and examination, starting with a six-week Academy programme on-site and delivered in English inclusive culture: 35+ nationalities, supportive networks and a strong DEI commitment facilities: on-site gym, health services, staff clubs and more (depending on location) top locations: high quality of life and a thriving international community (see full list of benefits) What to expect next We are recruiting for positions starting from 2027 and are already building a talent pool for upcoming roles in 2028. If selected to join our talent pool, you'll get: priority access to future vacancies exclusive access to learning offers and resources to enhance your IP awareness and your readiness to become a patent examiner regular updates and insights Being a member of the talent pool gives you a chance to join our journey from the very beginning and to be fully prepared for when the next positions go live. Process The successful candidate will be selected on the basis of qualifications, competencies, professional experience and language knowledge, supplemented as appropriate by technical assessments, interviews and/or a personality questionnaire. A talent pool (reserve list) will be constituted should more candidates than required at this time be considered suitable following the selection procedure. Such talent pools are valid for a period of 24 months and talent pool candidates may be contacted should a vacancy with substantially the same profile arise during that period. In line with the EPO's values and the standards of honesty and integrity expected of its employees, candidates are expected to uphold these same principles throughout the selection process. Candidates nevertheless remain responsible for the content of their application and for the accuracy of the information submitted – and we encourage candidates to ensure that their job application remains an authentic reflection of their own qualifications, skills and experience. During interviews and assessments, candidates are expected to rely on their own knowledge, experience and judgement, without the use of AI tools or other forms of real-time assistance, unless explicitly stated otherwise. review_candidates.title: Director of Infrastructure Services
review_candidates.description: The Technology pillar provides the secure, resilient and cost-effective foundations on which NHSE’s digital, data and operational services depend. It brings together the engineering, platforms and operational capabilities needed to run business-critical national and enterprise technology, support frontline services and enable wider digital transformation. Within the pillar, Infrastructure is responsible for on-premises and cloud hosting, networks and connectivity, cloud enablement, infrastructure engineering, platform lifecycle management, vulnerability and configuration management, technology asset management, operational resilience and the transition from legacy infrastructure to modern strategic platforms. The postholder will provide executive leadership for this portfolio, setting its strategy, service model, engineering standards and investment priorities while ensuring services are secure, reliable and financially sustainable. The role leads a large multidisciplinary team and significant supplier landscape, is accountable for major infrastructure operations and programmes, and provides assurance on performance, resilience, risk, cost and delivery. Working across NHS England, DHSC, the wider NHS, government and industry, the post holder will shape common infrastructure approaches, enable safe adoption of cloud and modern hosting, lead during major incidents and ensure that infrastructure decisions support better outcomes for patients, clinicians and frontline staff. Set the strategy and investment priorities for NHS England’s infrastructure services. Lead infrastructure operations, engineering, transformation and service improvement. Oversee hosting, cloud, networks, connectivity and the transition from legacy technology. Ensure services are secure, resilient, reliable, supportable and cost-effective. Provide assurance on performance, operational risk, cyber security, delivery and finances. Lead multidisciplinary teams, suppliers, major programmes and commercial relationships. Direct the response to major infrastructure incidents and drive continuous improvement. Advise senior leaders and collaborate across NHS England, DHSC, government and the wider NHS. NHS England has a wide range of statutory functions, responsibilities and regulatory powers. These are focused on supporting the wider NHS to deliver high quality care, as well as doing those things that are best done once for the whole NHS. Our staff bring expertise across clinical, operational, commissioning, technology, data science, cyber security, software engineering, education, and commercial specialisms — enabling us to design and deliver high-quality NHS services.
